meta.name: Clumsy Girlfriend Season 2
meta.description:
Riko (Akane Tsuchiyama), who is awkward in love, Miki (Yoko Fueki), who is beautiful but has too high ideals, and Shimizu (Ayu Enatsu), a man of great spirit who is adept at both love and work.

Joining the love scramble is the quiet, taciturn but kind-hearted Mr. Average Kimura (Fuyuyuki Dunk Asunaro)!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Riko (Akane Tsuchyama), who is clumsy when it comes to love, and Miki (Yoko Fueki), a beautiful woman with high ideals, spend all their time talking about love in the company's kitchen. One day, their boss introduces them to two male employees, Shimizu (Ayu Enatsu) and Tanaka (Akiyoshi Nel Sagawa), and Riko and Miki quickly become close with Shimizu and Tanaka.
